reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Disappointed that i paid $19.99 for this calendars app and the default iOS calendar does everything this does and for free. It also does not look like how it does in the AppStore photos. Part of me is wanting a refund for this.

reviews.title: No Blue Tooth capabilities
reviews.text: I've had Tiny Calendar Pro for many years now and have written in about how after an update, my Blue Tooth keyboard no longer works. The response I got was they will have their programmers look into it. The fix never happened, so I'm taking the review down to two stars.

reviews.title: Privacy questionable
reviews.text: You have to either give full access to your personal calendar or google calendar to use this app, which you do not find out until after you have paid for app access.
